This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 10-04-2026 (the "Effective
Date"), by and between Randstad Componenten BV, with its registered office at Keizersgracht 12,
Rotterdam ("Party A"), and Hollandse Precisie BV, with its registered office at Keizersgracht 12,
Rotterdam ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signatures

Party A   Randstad Componenten BV / Jan de Vries
Party B   Hollandse Precisie BV / Emma Bakker
